title: Monterey Bay Whale Watch
specs: Monterey Bay has the largest and deepest submarine canyon on the US west coast
Trips led by marine biologists and expert bird leaders
Rare seabird species and diverse marine mammals including whales and dolphins
No children under 12 on killer whale search trips
Pregnant people are highly recommended not to come on trips
Well behaved and leashed dogs welcome and free
Private charters available for 1 to 149 people

services.name: Fin Whale
services.desc: Fin Whales are occasionally encountered during the Summer and Fall in Monterey Bay, although they are more common in the open ocean. They are easily identified by their tall blow, dark body, large dorsal fin, and white coloration on their right lower jaw. Fin Whales are capable of traveling at speeds exceeding 20 knots. blurb: Guests join marine biologists on boat tours to watch whales, dolphins, seabirds, and other marine life in Monterey Bay. Trips range from 1 hour memorial charters to full-day pelagic seabird and killer whale search tours. The company focuses on education, conservation, and research, sharing data with nonprofit groups.
